candidate_models.name: Replace counter gate by CUSUM posterior
candidate_models.reason: Deletes the independent finite-surface support safeguard S12; the same reliable-cell score can coexist with support4/contradiction3 and support3/contradiction4. Original14cases requiredifferentactions.

candidate_models.name: Multiply raw-vote and CUSUM marginal likelihood ratios
candidate_models.reason: The two summaries reuse pixels/cells and time windows. Joint/conditional density is not provided by a product of marginal distributions. Need conditional observation law, not a tuning constant.

candidate_models.name: Posterior-predictive zero support on a replicate exposure
candidate_models.reason: A probability of no support in a future replicate is not the probability that the current physical state ended. It adds an unrequested predictive event; cannot relabel that as shared state likelihood.

candidate_models.name: Use q as Beta prior mean for raw spatial vote fraction
candidate_models.reason: q counts resolved temporal state opportunities; it is not the prior fraction of occupied ray intersections. This conflates transition probability with spatial measurement nuisance.

candidate_models.name: Literal support count gate as zero-noise measurement limit
candidate_models.reason: With exact physical-ID endpoint assignment, a contemporaneous own-ID return has zero likelihood under wholly absent oldsite. Softening needs the actual endpoint/range or temporal-change measurement likelihood; a new arbitrary false-positive probability is prohibited.
